Cherry Tartan ?

A rich, vintage-inspired aesthetic built around deep burgundy, wine red, muted rose and warm beige. Inspired by classic tartan patterns, cosy autumn evenings and timeless elegance. The look is bold yet understated, combining dark romantic tones with soft, warm details for a sophisticated finish.
info.additionalInfo: This is only for someone who loves burgundy. This gives soft vibes with a little deco. Hope u like this!
